audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill x5, Galio, Galio; the mirror audit settled the chart as Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Galio, Zaahen and the live rows already match that. 54.14% over 1679 games supports Zaahen edging the late game.
audit.corrected: Chart left as-is: five even rows, Galio's first-item window, Zaahen at two-plus items. No chart edits proposed, so no full/content pair is split.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text gave no cooldown numbers and named no real Zaahen ability in the full layer ("your committal tool", "your ultimate").
audit.why: Galio's real numbers: Winds of War (Q) 11/10/9/8/7, Shield of Durand (W) 18/17/16/15/14, Justice Punch (E) 11/10/9/8/7, Hero's Entrance (R) 180/160/140. Zaahen's are The Darkin Glaive (Q) 10s, Dreaded Return (W) 14s, Aureate Rush (E) 10s, Grim Deliverance (R) 110/95/80. Zaahen is on the shorter cooldowns in lane; Galio's W is the longest lane spell at 18s.
audit.corrected: Spikes and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the 18s Shield of Durand window, the 11s Justice Punch, the 180s Hero's Entrance and Zaahen's 110s R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors. (a) The content layer repeatedly calls Galio's W "Durand's Shield"; Riot's name is Shield of Durand. (b) spikes[3].text and late say "E Justice Punch taunt" — Justice Punch is the dash + knockup; the taunt is Shield of Durand (W).
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names: W "Galio charges a defensive stance... Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemies" (hardCC, shield, slow). E "briefly step back and charge, knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters" (dash, terrain). Telling a player the taunt is on E makes them dodge the wrong spell. Also missing: Colossal Smash (P) is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up, not a cast, is the tell to step back.
audit.corrected: Taunt attributed to Shield of Durand (W), knockup to Justice Punch (E), and the Colossal Smash auto-reset wind-up named as the step-back cue. Galio's Winds of War is a projectile pair; Zaahen's Aureate Rush (E) deals percent health, so Galio's magic-tank stacking does not blunt it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Passive auto-reset tell absent from every layer.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags it as applicable and unmentioned.

edits.before: Galio's early lane is passive — he pokes with Q Winds of War and shields magic with W Durand's Shield; play around his mana and trade with Q Darkin Glaive when his W is on cooldown, since neither of you has kill pressure yet.
edits.after: Galio's early lane is passive — he pokes with Winds of War (Q) and eats magic with Shield of Durand (W), 18s at rank 1; trade with The Darkin Glaive inside that window and punish the mana, since his Q costs 60 and neither of you kills yet.

edits.before: Galio R Hero's Entrance is a global peel-and-knockup, but 1v1 it does little to you; the lane stays even as he mostly uses it to roam or assist teammates.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is a global peel-and-knockup on 180s at rank 1, and 1v1 it does little to you; the lane stays even while he banks it to roam or bail out a teammate.

edits.before: With one item Galio's W taunt-and-shield tankiness plus Q sustained magic poke start winning the extended trade, and his passive on-hit chunks you every few autos.
edits.after: With one item Shield of Durand's taunt-and-shield plus Winds of War poke start winning the extended trade, and Colossal Smash resets his auto — the wind-up is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Two items deep Galio is a magic-damage tank who shrugs off your physical burst with W Durand's Shield and E Justice Punch taunt; don't force solo fights, use your push to deny his roams.
edits.after: Two items deep Galio is a magic tank shrugging off your burst with Shield of Durand — that W is the taunt, not Justice Punch (E), which is his dash-knockup; don't duel him, push to deny his roams.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is a skill lane — Galio just wants to poke with Q Winds of War and manage mana, while you look for a clean Q Darkin Glaive when his W Durand's Shield is down.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is a skill lane — Galio pokes with Winds of War and watches his mana, while you look for a clean The Darkin Glaive inside the 18s Shield of Durand cooldown.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay even and skill-based; Galio has no early kill threat and his R Hero's Entrance is a roaming tool rather than a 1v1 weapon, so the lane comes down to who lands their poke cleaner.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay even; Galio has no solo kill threat and Hero's Entrance is a roam tool rather than a 1v1 weapon, so the lane is whoever pokes cleaner — step up on every Justice Punch he whiffs.

edits.before: With items Galio's magic-tank scaling takes over — W Durand's Shield eats your physical burst, E Justice Punch taunts you out of your combo, and his passive on-hit grinds you down, so play the map instead of the duel.
edits.after: With items Galio's magic-tank scaling takes over — Shield of Durand eats your burst and taunts, Justice Punch knocks you up out of your combo, and Colossal Smash grinds you down, so play the map instead of the duel.

edits.before: Trade when his W Durand's Shield is on cooldown
edits.after: Trade inside the 18s Shield of Durand window

edits.before: Shield your burst with W Durand's Shield and taunt with E
edits.after: Shield your burst and taunt with Shield of Durand (W)

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (E): 11s at rank 1, his dash-knockup engage; the taunt is Shield of Durand (W) at 18s. Step up when either is spent. - Aureate Rush (E): never spend it on chip. - Grim Deliverance (R): 110s, kill windows only.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Justice Punch is his dash-knockup engage, 11s at rank 1. Commit only once it is spent or baited out.

edits.before: Your R is the kill window — build your teamfight around that. Galio carry threat: 6/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Grim Deliverance heals off its own damage — build the fight around that 110s window. Galio threat 6/10: shift to picks and wave control if he leads.

notes: The content layer used the fabricated name "Durand's Shield" for Galio's W (real name Shield of Durand) and, worse, attributed his taunt to Justice Punch (E) in two places — E is the dash+knockup, W is the taunt. Both fixed. The full layer still contains generic placeholders for Zaahen's own abilities in several unedited strings (tradeGood, dontsFull[1].d, report[11].t reference "mobility"/"committal tool" rather than Aureate Rush / Dreaded Return); the ones inside the length band were rewritten, the rest are too short to carry the real name without breaking the band.
